description: This file defines the interface for a Dispatcher component within the WPEFramework plugin host namespace. It declares the IDispatcher interface, its nested ICallback interface, and related methods for event handling, validation, invocation, and management of callbacks, used for remote procedure calls and message dispatching.

classes.name: IDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for dispatching remote method calls and managing callbacks.

classes.name: IDispatcher::ICallback
classes.description: Callback interface for handling events, errors, and responses.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token for a given method with parameters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method asynchronously with a callback and receives a response.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revoke a callback, stopping further callback invocations.

methods.name: Local
methods.description: Provides access to the local dispatcher if needed.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Reports an error with channel, id, code, and message.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Sends a response message for a given request.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an event with a designator.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from an event with a designator.

ctags.name: ICallback
ctags.pattern: /^            struct EXTERNAL ICallback : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IDispatcher : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
